enchantments.tooltip: Freedom of Movement: This item grants its wearer the ability to move and attack normally while under the influence of magic that impedes movement, such as paralysis, solid fog, slow and web.
Speed +30%: +30% enhancement bonus to movement speed, 15% bonus to attack speed.
Dexterity +9: This item makes the wearer more nimble and dexterous, granting a +9 Enhancement bonus to Dexterity.
Exceptional Nimble Skills Bonus: +8 Exceptional bonus to Balance, Hide, Move Silently, Open Lock and Tumble.
Epic Kundarak Delving Equipment: 3 Pieces Equipped: +2 Artifact bonus to Sneak Attack Dice. +10% Artifact bonus to Helplessness Damage. +10% Artifact bonus to Doublestrike and Doubleshot
